interact.GatherTypeMissmatch: You must equip a proper tool to harvest this resource.

2000.name: Efficient Diet
2000.desc: You can gain more Fullness from the same food.
2000.h: Fullness recovery items recover #recoverySatietyR% more Fullness.

2001.name: Max Fullness Increase
2001.desc: Permanently increases your max Fullness. It does not increase your stomach size.

2002.name: Max Acting Power Increase
2002.desc: Permanently increases your max Acting Power.

2003.name: Max HP Increase
2003.desc: Increases your max HP. \r\n\r\n #c* Required Trait: Max Acting Power Increase Level 10 or higher

2004.name: Weather Adaptation Boost
2004.desc: Reduces the Heat Wave and Squall's effect on your Fullness and Acting Power.

2005.name: Tough Lifeline
2005.desc: Grants you a Protective Shield when your HP is 10% or lower.

2006.name: Danger Escape
2006.desc: Increases your Speed when your Acting Power is 30% or lower. \r\n\r\n #c* Required Trait: Max HP Increase Level 10 or higher

2007.name: Field Bishop
2007.desc:
Allows you to make potions that recover both Acting Power and HP. 
 - Level 1: Acting Power Recovery Potion (XL) recipe added 
 - Level 2: HP Recovery Potion (XL) recipe added 

 #c* Required Trait: Efficient Diet Level 10 or higher

2008.name: Emergency Food
2008.desc:
Emergency food that tastes bad but has a long shelf life is provided in your supplies. 
 - Stage 1: Energy Bar x1 given 
 - Stage 2: Energy Bar x2 given 
 - Stage 3: Canned Food x2 given

 #c* Required Trait: Field Bishop Level 2 or higher, Survival Architect Level 1 or higher

2010.name: Resource Gatherer
2010.desc: Grants a chance to obtain more resources when harvesting.

2011.name: Loot Collector
2011.desc: Grants a chance to find additional loot when defeating enemies.

2013.name: Thrifty Carpenter
2013.desc: Reduces the amount of logs used in production.

2014.name: Thrifty Mason
2014.desc: Reduces the amount of stones used in production.

2015.name: Survival Architect
2015.desc:
Allows you to make a bigger storage room, a longer-lasting bonfire, and more durable stone walls. 
 - Level 1: Improved Storage Room recipe added 
 - Level 2: Improved Bonfire recipe added 
 Level 3: Sturdy Advanced Stone Wall recipe added

 #c* Required Trait: Clever Harvesting Level 10 or higher

2016.name: Repair Durability
2016.desc:
You can make potions that repair durability of a weapon or a tool. 
 - Level 1: Whetstone recipe added

 #c* Required Trait: Master of Harvesting Level 15 or higher

2017.name: Preparations to Advance
2017.desc:
A Survival Worktable given as part of your supplies. 
 - Level 1: Survival Worktable given upon entry

 #c* Required Trait: Survival Architect Level 3 or higher, Innate Talent Level 10 or higher

2020.name: Appropriate Potion Consumption
2020.desc: Improves Acting Power recovery potion's absorption to increase the recovery amount.
2020.h: Acting Power Recovery Items recover #recoveryStaminaR% more Acting Power.

2023.name: Combative Instinct
2023.desc: You have a chance to recover HP when you inflict damage to enemies.

2024.name: Innate Talent
2024.desc: Increases Basic Attack Power. \r\n\r\n #c* Required Trait: Swift Hands Level 3 or higher

2025.name: High Quality Attack Power Potion
2025.desc:
You can make a further improved Attack Power potions. 
 - Stage 1: Attack Power Explosion Potion recipe added

 #c* Required Trait: Appropriate Potion Consumption Level 10 or higher

2026.name: Combative Move
2026.desc:
A useful weapon given as part of your supplies. 
 - Level 1: Special Iron Sword given upon entry

 #c* Required Trait: High Quality Attack Power Potion Level 1 or higher, Danger Escape Level 5 or higher

2027.name: Protection of Solid Earth
2027.desc: Blessed by the energy of sturdy earth, HP increases.
2027.h: Max Life Force is increased by {maxHP:g}

2028.name: Protection of Seething Earth
2028.desc: Blessed by the energy of seething earth, Attack Power increases.

2029.name: Protection of Abundant Earth
2029.desc: Blessed by the abundance of the earth, Fullness increases.

2030.name: Hunger
2030.desc: You are extremely hungry! Your Acting Power continues to drain.

2031.name: Exhausted
2031.desc: You ran out of Acting Power! Your Speed and Jump are lowered, and your attacks and harvesting are less effective.

2032.name: Comfort
2032.desc: You are full and feeling strong. You continuously recover HP over time.

2033.name: Getting over the Fear
2033.desc: The bright light helps you get over the fear, increasing Attack Power and Defense.

2034.name: Squall
2034.desc: A sudden shower falls upon the island. The harsh weather makes you use more Acting Power.

2035.name: Heat Wave
2035.desc: A heat wave emerges. You feel tired faster, and you feel more hungry.

2036.name: Fog
2036.desc: A thick fog blankets the surroundings, making it harder to see.

2037.name: Gentle breeze
2037.desc: A nice breeze surrounds you. You use less Acting Power and Fullness drains more slowly.

2038.name: Swimming in the Dark
2038.desc: There is no way to swim safely in the pitch-black darkness!\r\n\r\nLife Force and Acting Power drain quickly.

3004.name: Magic Wings
3004.desc: You can fly with this pair of Magic Wings. \r\n#c - Enables the Flying Skill\r\n - Max Mount Duration: 180 seconds

3005.name: Airplane
3005.desc: You can fly through the air quickly aboard this airplane. \r\n#c - Enables the Flying Skill\r\n - Max Mount Duration: 300 seconds

2039.name: Protection of Sturdy Earth
2039.desc: Blessed by the sturdy earth, HP increases.

2040.name: Protection of Seething Earth
2040.desc: Blessed by the seething earth, Attack Power increases.

2041.name: Protection of Abundant Earth
2041.desc: Blessed by the abundant earth, Fullness increases.

4000.name: Attack Power enhancement
4000.desc: You'll start with a higher Attack Power.
4000.h: When you start, Attack Power is increased by {attackPowerRate:g}%

4001.name: Tower Attack Power enhancement
4001.desc: Can be placed by further enhancing the Attack Power of the tower to be installed.
4001.h: When you start, Attack Power of the tower is increased by {towerAttack:g}%

4002.name: Defense enhancement
4002.desc: You'll start with a higher Defense.
4002.h: When you start, Defense is increased by {defensePower:g}%

4003.name: Attack speed enhancement
4003.desc: You'll start with a higher Attack Speed.
4003.h: When you start, Attack Speed is increased by {x:g} stage

4004.name: Nocturnal Enhancement
4004.h: Damage dealt at night is increased by {attackPowerNight:g}

4005.name: Max life force enhancement
4005.desc: You'll start with a higher HP.
4005.h: When you start, max HP is increased by {maxHP:g}

4006.name: Max Fullness enhancement
4006.h: When you start, max Fullness is increased by {maxSatiety:g}

4007.name: Max Acting power enhancement
4007.desc: You'll start with higher Acting Power.
4007.h: When you start, max Acting Power is increased by {maxStamina:g}

4008.name: Speed enhancement
4008.h: When you start, Speed is increased by {speed:g}

4009.name: Jump enhancement
4009.h: When you start, Jump is increased by {jump:g}

4010.name: Survival Architect
4010.desc: Harvesting tool and survival worktable are provided as supplies upon entry.
4010.h: - Stage 1: <Stone Axe, Stone Pickax> are given \r\n- Stage 2: <Survival Worktable, Stone Axe, Stone Pickax> are given \r\n- Stage 3: <Industrial Worktable, Steel Axe, Steel Pickax> are given

4011.name: Emergency Food
4011.desc: Emergency food that tastes bad but has a long shelf life is provided as a supply upon entry.
4011.h: - Level 1: <Energy Bar x1, Hardtack x1> are given \r\n - Level 2: <Energy Bar x1, Hardtack x1, Canned Food x1> are given \r\n - Level 3: <Energy Bar x1, Hardtack x1, Canned Food x1, Chocolate x1> are given

4012.name: Combative Move
4012.desc: When entering, you'll start with a pretty useful weapon equipped.
4012.h: - Level 1: <Wooden Sword> is equipped as default \r\n- Level 2: <Iron Sword> is equipped as default \r\n- Level 3: <Golden Sword> is equipped as default

4013.name: Clever Battle
4013.desc: When entering, you'll start with armor equipped that can protect your body.
4013.h: - Level 1: <Leather Armor, Sandals> are equipped as default \r\n- Level 2: <Gladiator Armor, Sloppy Leather Shoes> are equipped as default \r\n- Level 3: <Plate Armor, Studded Shoes, Leather Hat> are equipped as default

4014.name: Exploration Designer
4014.desc: When entering, you will be given building facilities necessary for exploration.
4014.h: - Level 1: <Bonfire x1> is given \r\n - Level 2: <Bonfire x1, Palm Tent x1> are given \r\n - Level 3: <Bonfire x1, Palm Tent x1, Wooden Box x1> are given

4015.name: Harvesting Power enhancement
4015.desc: Harvesting power of harvesting Tool is increased.
4015.h: Harvesting Tool's resource harvesting power is increased by {gatherPowerRate:g}%

2046.name: Heat and shower immunity
2046.desc: Not affected by the penalty of Fullness and Acting Power due to heat and shower.

chapter1.str:
There are countless rumors and stories tangled in The Misty Island.
There's a large ruin in the center.
What is the identity of the center ruin that appeared.
Let's pursue the whereabouts of the hidden truth and uncover the truth that has come to the island.

chapter2.str:
Goblins and Lizardmen swarm to claim the Lava Stone. Their greed has brought upon an anomaly on the island. Why are they trying to conquer Lava Stone so much? 
We need to find a way to solve this situation as soon as possible.

chapter3.str:
There is only one way to protect the island. It's no longer possible to avoid a head-on confrontation with the Goblins. We must stop them before they go into a state of frenzy.
What is the final battle the expedition will face, and the fate of The Misty Island...?

endless.str: Protecting the ruins was successful, but it is said that the Misty Island is still surrounded in mystery. Let's clean up the remaining remnants and investigate the island. Thus, our exploration will continue...
